items.title: Orchid’s Edge
items.description: A woodland axe with a leaf-inlaid steel cheek, a jewel at its heart and a wrapped grip. Its chopping and Shelter ability remain part of the game.

items.title: Copperpot’s Hammer
items.description: Forged steel, copper collars and a maker’s mark. A familiar apprentice’s tool, given a more carefully finished home in your hand.

items.title: Glowmoth Lantern
items.description: A brass lantern with translucent moth wings. In game, the trigger releases its hovering light companion; a second press calls it home.

items.title: Stormbell
items.description: A hollow bronze bell suspended in a forged yoke. Strike to gather charge, then release it as an aimed concussive chime.
